## Verification
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] `cargo build --workspace`
- [ ] Fixture demo, if Windows monitoring changed

## Safety and privacy
- [ ] No deletion without an explicit, reviewed action
- [ ] No new data upload or telemetry
